references.text: The regulation concerning the wave offering of the breast and the heave offering of the thigh as the priests' portion. Moses here follows the instructions given earlier that the breast is to be waved as a wave offering before the Lord.
Specific instruction that the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons. In the ordination offering, the breast falls to Moses as the serving priest.
Parallel text from the instructions in Exodus where Moses is told to take the breast of the ram of ordination and wave it as a wave offering, and that it shall be his portion.
The preceding context where Aaron and his sons wave the offering before the Lord before Moses takes his share of the breast.
Confirmation that the wave offering belongs to the priests as their share of the offerings.
Another example of a wave offering of the breast that falls to the priest as a holy gift.
